# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Metal GPU Monitor — Real-Time GPU Monitoring for macOS</h2>

<p>
    Monitor your Apple GPU performance directly inside your JetBrains IDE.
    Metal GPU Monitor provides real-time utilization metrics, memory tracking,
    thermal state reporting, and per-process GPU usage — all without leaving your editor.
    Powered by native macOS IOKit APIs for accurate, low-overhead data collection.
</p>

<h3>🆓 Free Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li>📊 <b>Status Bar Widget</b> — At-a-glance GPU utilization with color-coded indicator</li>
    <li>📈 <b>Live Charts</b> — Real-time utilization and memory graphs in a dedicated tool window</li>
    <li>🌡️ <b>Thermal State</b> — Monitor GPU thermal status (Nominal → Critical)</li>
    <li>🔍 <b>Process Tracking</b> — See top GPU-consuming processes at a glance</li>
    <li>⏱️ <b>5-Minute History</b> — Short-term charts for recent GPU activity</li>
    <li>💻 <b>Device Info</b> — GPU model, vendor, core count, and architecture details</li>
</ul>

<h3>💎 Pro Features ($3.90/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>📅 24-hour extended history with scrollable charts</li>
    <li>🔔 Configurable alerts for GPU utilization and memory thresholds</li>
    <li>📤 Data export to JSON or CSV for external analysis</li>
    <li>📋 Full per-process GPU usage with IDE process highlighting</li>
    <li>🎨 Custom dashboard layouts</li>
</ul>

<h3>Free vs Pro</h3>
<table>
    <tr><th>Feature</th><th>Free</th><th>Pro</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Status bar widget</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Live charts & tool window</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Thermal monitoring</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>5-minute history</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Basic process tracking</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>24-hour history</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Configurable alerts</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Data export (JSON/CSV)</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Full process list</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Custom layouts</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td></tr>
</table>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>macOS 14+</b> (Sonoma or later) — uses native IOKit APIs</li>
    <li>Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) or Intel Mac with integrated/discrete GPU</li>
    <li>IntelliJ Platform 2024.2 or later</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/metal-gpu-monitor-plugin/issues">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="mailto:support@jakubjirak.com">Contact Support</a> |
    <a href="https://htmeta.dev">Website</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Real-time GPU monitoring for macOS developers — right in your IDE.

**Short Description (155 chars):** Real-time GPU monitoring for macOS — track utilization, memory, thermals, and per-process usage directly in your JetBrains IDE. Free core + Pro at $3.90/mo.
